name: fk_dev
cmd: mkdir -p /workspace/fieldk_20261125/runs/fk_dev && OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 /workspace/acupuncture/.venv-bench/bin/python /workspace/fieldk_20261125/code/fk_run.py --model /workspace/models/Qwen3-8B-b968826d --scenes /workspace/fieldk_20261125/scenes.jsonl --split dev --ratios 0.5,0.7,0.8,0.9 --out /workspace/fieldk_20261125/runs/fk_dev/records.jsonl && echo '{"complete": true}' > /workspace/fieldk_20261125/runs/fk_dev/complete.json

name: fk_qualify
cmd: mkdir -p /workspace/fieldk_20261125/runs/fk_qualify && OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 /workspace/acupuncture/.venv-bench/bin/python /workspace/fieldk_20261125/code/fk_qualify.py --records /workspace/fieldk_20261125/runs/fk_dev/records.jsonl --ratios 0.5,0.7,0.8,0.9 --model-config /workspace/models/Qwen3-8B-b968826d/config.json --out /workspace/fieldk_20261125/QUALIFICATION.json && echo '{"complete": true}' > /workspace/fieldk_20261125/runs/fk_qualify/complete.json

name: fk_confirm
